lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition In6Bi6Au2 (reduced formula In3Bi3Au) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Au centers surrounded by 8 neighbors (4 Bi, 4 In), while both Bi and In centers have 9 neighbors (4 Au, 3 Bi, 2 In), with neighbor distances ranging from about 3.15 to 3.29 Å. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates corner- and edge-sharing between Au and Bi polyhedra and corner-sharing between Bi and In polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
